title: OASIS UNCOVERS: HIGH-QUALITY T2I MODELS, SAME OLD STEREOTYPES

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting text-to-image models with neutral nationality concepts (e.g., 'A photo of an Iranian person') and quantifying the over-representation and spectral variance of stereotypical cultural attributes (e.g., traditional clothing, specific facial hair) using CLIP features, alongside tracking the emergence of these attributes in the model's latent space.

Measuring the gender distribution in generated images for professions (e.g., 'doctor') and specific nationalities using zero-shot CLIP classification, and comparing these generated distributions to real-world demographic census data.

Evaluating the frequency of age-related attributes (e.g., 'old') in generated images for specific nationalities using vision-language models, and calculating the deviation from true real-world age demographics.

Detecting the over-representation of religious attire (e.g., turbans, hijab) and the model's internal association with religious terminology (e.g., 'Imam', 'Sheikh') when given neutral nationality prompts, utilizing multimodal feature similarity and prompt optimization techniques.
